offers_products.reason: Main business is buying nonperforming loan portfolios and collecting on them; no goods or software sold.

offers_services.reason: Purchase, collection and management of nonperforming loans, plus fee-based recovery services for banks and institutional investors; financial services.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Indebted consumers are collected from, not buyers; the customers choosing to sell are banks and lenders.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Banks and credit issuers sell it loan portfolios; institutional investors and corporates buy its recovery services.

recurring_revenue.reason: Ongoing collections on owned loan portfolios and repeat portfolio purchases from banks give continuing cash flows.

cyclical_demand.reason: Banks sell nonperforming loans in downturns, and collections are needed regardless; demand is not easily postponed.

big_ticket.reason: Portfolio purchases are large but recurring; the business is many small collections on individual accounts. Judged mixed, leaning no.

people_delivered.reason: Value comes from capital deployed in purchased loan portfolios and analytics, not mainly staff time sold to clients.

large_customers.reason: Main clients are large banks and credit issuers, plus institutional investors and corporate clients.

asset_heavy.reason: Growth needs financial capital for portfolio purchases and call-center offices, not plants, fleets or networks.

notes: Debt buyer: consumers are the debtors, not the buyers. The big_ticket and asset_heavy answers are judgment calls.
